profile.headline: Senior Front End Software Engineer @ Amazon
profile.summary:
I'm a results-driven Senior Front-End Engineer passionate about building exceptional, high-performance web applications that genuinely enhance user experiences. My expertise includes modern web technologies such as React, TypeScript, AWS, and Micro Frontend architectures. With a proven track record of strategic innovation and leadership. Beyond technology, I'm genuinely motivated by mentoring teams, supporting individual growth, and multiplying impact through strategic leadership and innovation. Throughout my career, I've successfully accelerated deployment cycles, enhanced system reliability, and consistently delivered solutions that drive meaningful business outcomes.

Looking ahead, I'm excited to continue driving innovation at the intersection of front-end development and scalable, user-focused design. I'm particularly interested in roles and projects that challenge me to leverage cutting-edge technologies to solve complex business problems, foster collaboration, and contribute to team growth and product excellence.

🚀 KEY SKILLS

🌐 Languages & Frameworks
• React | TypeScript | JavaScript (ES6+) | HTML5 | CSS3  

📐 Architectures & Patterns
• Micro Frontends | Design Systems | Component-Based Architecture | Responsive Web Design  

☁️ Cloud & Tools
• AWS (CloudFront, Route 53, S3, Lambda, Amplify) | Docker | Kubernetes | Webpack | Jenkins  

🤝 Leadership & Collaboration
• Technical Leadership | Mentorship | Cross-functional Collaboration | UX/UI Strategy  


I'm always eager to exchange insights, collaborate on exciting projects, and explore new opportunities. Let's connect!
📧 VrturoPerez@gmail.com

positions.title: Senior Front End Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Designed and led delivery of a unified Navbar foundational for adoption of AI-powered UI tools across all accounting team's new UI, accelerating troubleshooting by 93%.
● Led design of reusable UI components, reducing configuration complexity by 90% (from 1,000+ elements down to 58).
● Architected scalable front-end infrastructure supporting 160% user growth across multiple international markets.
● Established front-end coding standards and integrated ESLint/Prettier, reducing code review time, and improving codebase consistency across teams.
● Authored comprehensive TypeScript guidelines, standardizing use of interfaces/types, improving developer efficiency, and reducing type-related errors.

positions.title: Front End Software Engineer II
positions.description:
● Designed and implemented a scalable Reverse Proxy container framework using AWS CloudFront and Route 53, consolidating over 15 front-end applications and improving load times by 40%.
● Designed and deployed a Micro Frontend architecture, enabling independent deployments and reducing downtime by 50%.
● Optimized app performance through strategic caching, SSL termination, and intelligent routing, achieving 40% faster response times.
● Integrated robust security measures including authentication, authorization, and secure routing, reducing vulnerabilities by 60% and ensuring full compliance with organizational standards.
● Established standardized reusable component libraries and consistent UI/UX standards, reducing development time by 50% and branding inconsistencies by 80%.
● Delivered rapid scalability for front-end applications, significantly increasing user adoption, retention, and overall growth.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
● Owned UI engineering for Amazon’s global B2B invoicing platform, driving scalable growth across 20+ international markets.
● Led complete tech-stack revamp for critical financial web app, cutting JS load time by 75% (7.67s to 1.93s), improving page load speed by 46%.
● Redesigned heaviest-used page of financial web app, achieving 83% faster initial load (3.1s to 0.52s) and boosting UI responsiveness 10x (5 to 50+ FPS).
● Introduced advanced Web Analytics, automating performance monitoring and reducing manual reporting efforts by 90%, enabling data-driven decisions.
● Designed and implemented React-based front-end, automating invoicing tasks and reducing manual workload by over 40%.

Technologies: React, AWS tools (Lambdas, SNS, Data Pipelines), Java, JavaScript(Node.js), HTML, CSS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Designed and architected UI/UX of company web application using JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 and Bootstrap.
● Allowed users to upload photos and incorporated AWS S3 buckets with endpoints to render image files.
● Engineered PostgreSQL DB schema with ActiveRecord to handle models with 40+ attributes.
● Persisted 400+ listing images for all users in AWS S3 and deployed web application and assets to AWS EC2.
● Built out administrator view using JavaScript to establish which users had access to admin privileges.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Mentor
positions.description:
● Pair programmed with 100+ students on technologies such as Ruby, Rails, Sinatra, RSpec, JavaScript, SQL, and ActiveRecord, teaching Ruby best practices and OOP design principles.
● Lectured on data structures (linked lists, stacks, queues) and algorithm design principles to >50 engineers.
● Provided in-depth code reviews of Ruby and JavaScript features following agile development methodologies.
● Troubleshoot errors with students by walking them through the underlying logic of the code as well as determining edge cases

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Stock training platform for market enthusiasts that allows you to upload and backtest your own trading algorithms.

● Designed the navigation bar, custom forms, and UI/UX of entire app using Bootstrap and custom CSS/JS.
● Applied the HighCharts API, a Dashboard/Admin type view is given, displaying given data onto the charts.
● Leveraged CodeMirror API to display a text editor for users to create algorithms to manipulate stock data.
● Migrated to EJS to embed JavaScript logic in the views to determine what to display based on specific criteria.

positions.title: Sales Affiliate and Marketing
positions.description:
● Developed successful sales and marketing strategies, exceeding the revenue forecast by ~300% every quarter.
● Mentored 450+ new sales a iliates to develop their skills in order to increase confidence and productivity.
● Hosted and gave talks to over 200+ people at company networking events and training programs.

positions.title: Upholsterer
positions.description:
● Being able to provide excellent detailed work over extended periods of time
● Communicate clearly and positively with coworkers and management as we work as a team on a 
daily basis
● Took initiative to find extra tasks when scheduled duties were completed
● Worked with tools for up to 10 – 12 hours a day
● Being able to upholster an entire couch from beginning to the very end details within minutes

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Troubleshoot errors with students by walking them through the underlying logic of the code as well as determining edge cases
• Help students on topics such as OOP best practices, ruby fundamentals, and algorithmic problem solving

projects.title: Notester
projects.description:
Advanced note-taking tool for users to easily crowd-source information on specific topics, organized in a hierarchy.

● Followed single-page design pattern using Sass to allow for an intuitive, streamlined, and simplified UI/UX.
● Organized front-end logic using Backbone.js to handle the creation and saving of notes in the local storage.
● Constructed highly integrated DB using ActiveRecord and PostgreSQL to establish polymorphic associations
and self-referential tables to store users, notes, resources and tags.
● Visualized an interactive library of notes and associated subcategories as a graph data structure using D3.

projects.title: B.A.C.E. (Blood Alcohol Content Estimator)
projects.description:
Estimation tool for late night party-goers to calculate their B.A.C based on weight, gender, time, and consumption.

● Engineered an algorithm using Ruby that return a user’s Blood Alcohol Content with the weight, gender, oz’s of alcohol consumed, and time since first drink that the user provides.
● Followed TDD (RSpec, Capybara) for unit and functional tests to validate DB changes and HTTP responses.
